slides.title: Each milestone closes with the deliverables that prove it

node.text: Team, governance and plan in place; steering committee chartered.
Access and revenue cycle baseline agreed with operations leads.
Future-state scheduling, registration and billing design approved.
Workflows, rules and interfaces configured and unit tested.
Users pass every critical script with no open severity 1 or 2 defects.
Central scheduling and two hospitals move to the new workflows.
The remaining hospitals and ambulatory clinics go live.
KPIs stable for four weeks; support handed to Northfield teams.
